_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
RUN now shows only the requested activity patterns: a one-second cycle (0.5 s on, 0.5 s off) for each 5 mmHg of inflation/deflation, with overlapping triggers merged; PVR and wait flash every five seconds. Boot, knob, legacy state-machine and RUN fault flashes are removed. ON/OFF fault indications and safety actions remain.

PVR calculation circles start at the far left and advance without wrapping or moving backward during recovery checks. The far-right circle appears with the actual target or fallback on the existing result screen. The GUI mirrors the hardware LED bits and OLED frames.

Application v3.1.370 bundles firmware rev27v-followup-347, dated 11/10/2026. Protocol names, estimator, SNR, pressure limits, calibration, PID and protocol timing are unchanged.

Validation: 64 focused tests passed; firmware compiled successfully. Protected device C flash/restore verified saved calibration and controls. Actual Smart Const, High Max and fallback runs passed control and circle checks, returning 93.88, 136.19 and 80 mmHg in 8.053, 7.179 and 9.526 seconds. Delivery was 14,311/14,311 frames (100%). STOP cancellation was also verified.

Ten-minute seed 213 soak: **26,614/26,614 frames delivered (100%)**; all six scored reversal/monotonicity checks passed.

| Cycle / preset | Measured slope mmHg/s | Command mmHg/s | Verdict |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 / Smart Const | 3.62 | 4.00 | PASS |
| 2 / Arm CVP | 0.94 | 1.00 | PASS |
| 3 / Smart Const | 3.61 | 4.00 | PASS |
| 4 / Wrist CVP | 0.97 | 1.00 | PASS |
| 5 / Regular | 3.60 | 4.00 | PASS |
| 6 / High Max | 3.56 | 4.00 | PASS |

Non-CVP slopes use the 150-40 mmHg band; CVP uses its full deflation window. PASS does not imply exact slope tracking.

The separate firmware346 simulator sweep completed 52 runs: 42 accepted, 10 fallbacks and no accepted error above 10 mmHg in that sweep. Accepted error was +2.35 +/- 3.29 mmHg; calculation took 6.13-9.56 seconds. All control checks passed with 100% delivery. Reference MAP is calculated as DBP+(SBP-DBP)/3. Prior failures remain in the validation record; repeated simulator results do not establish clinical accuracy or a zero-error guarantee.

Human numerical replay is unchanged: among 2,825 usable radial references, 2,480 accepted and 345 fell back to 80. Accepted peaks were within 10 mmHg in 70.6% of cases, with 728 above 10 mmHg. Live Arduino deadlines may add fallbacks. This remains a research PVR target, not a validated arterial MAP measurement.

This installer is unsigned under the operator's existing authorization. On a first installation, choose More info -> Run anyway if SmartScreen appears. Existing Latest clients receive the verified Default update through the existing idle/pump-off/vented update gate and protected firmware snapshot/flash/restore path.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
